hospice.title: Night at the Rec!
hospice.description:
october with EHH 🧡

we have so many exciting events coming up this month, with plenty of ways to get involved, connect with patients and get to know more about elite healthcare hospice! 

🚨 interested in becoming a member and volunteering with us for patient visits? join us for our FIRST GENERAL MEETING on October 16! this is your LAST chance to begin the Fall onboarding process. after onboarding closes, patient/group visits are for members only 🚨

save the dates & we hope to see you throughout the month <3

latin.title: Latinx Heritage Soccer Night
latin.description:
Happy first week familia!!✨

As we begin this new academic year. Chicano Student Programs invites you to our Chicana/o/x & Latina/o/x Mes De Herencia events that will take place starting next week!!✨🥳🤗
Whether you are a student, faculty, staff or community member we will love to see you in our events!!💙💛

Hope to see you there!!✨❤️‍🩹

latin.title: MSOC: Highlanders Game (Latin Heritage Night)
latin.description:
If you’re not at a Highlanders game, you’re missing the main event! 🐻🔥 #FOMO

Check out these upcoming games... and don’t forget: UCR students are FREE at home with R’Card! 🎟️✨ 

Can’t make it in person? Highlander fans can now watch UCR worldwide! 🌍 All home games are streaming internationally on bigwest.org/watch & Disney+ International 📺

🗓️ Upcoming Schedule: 
🏐 WVB: TODAY | 4 p.m. 📍 SRC Arena
⚽ WSOC: TODAY | 7:00 p.m.📍UCR Soccer Stadium
⚽ MSOC: Wed., Oct. 7 | 7:00 p.m.📍UCR Soccer Stadium (Latin Heritage Night) 🎉
🏐 WVB: Fri., Oct. 9 | 6:00 p.m.📍SRC Arena
⚽ MSOC: Sat., Oct. 10 | 7:00 p.m. @ California Baptist University (Cross Town Showdown) ⚔️
🏃 XC: Sat., Oct. 17 | 📍Ag/Ops Cross Country Course (Highlander Invitational) 🏃‍♂️💨

Full schedule at gohighlanders.com

#ucr #UCRiverside #UCRAthletics #GoHighlanders

axo.title: Recruitment registration deadline
axo.description:
ALPHA CHI’S 2026 RECRUITMENT VIDEO 💖✨

A little glimpse into the sisterhood we’re so lucky to call ours. These are just a few of the countless moments, memories, laughs, and friendships that make Alpha Chi feel like home. There’s so much more than we could ever fit into one video, but we hope this gives you a little look into what makes our sisterhood so special. 💌

Reminder: Recruitment registration closes October 5th! Register through the link in our bio!!we can’t wait to meet you MC ‘26! ❤️💚

#ucr #alphachiomega #recruitment

The Chinese Student Association (CSA) at UC Riverside is a social, cultural, and service oriented organization that strives to promote Chinese American culture throughout the UCR and Riverside communities. Our organization is a great way to meet lifelong friends and create fond memories that will contribute to a successful college experience and beyond!
